question: For German drivers born between 1975 and 1985, find the one with the highest total points in driver standings. Provide their full name, total points, and average fastest lap time in seconds across all their races.

WITH eligible_drivers AS (
    SELECT XCL_034, XCL_038, XCL_039
    FROM drivers
    WHERE XCL_041 = 'German'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', XCL_040) BETWEEN '1975' AND '1985'
),
driver_points AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034, SUM(ds.XCL_030) AS total_points
    FROM eligible_drivers d
    JOIN driverStandings ds ON d.XCL_034 = ds.XCL_029
    GROUP BY d.XCL_034
),
top_driver AS (
    SELECT XCL_034, total_points
    FROM driver_points
    ORDER BY total_points DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

    SELECT r.XCL_075,
           (CAST(SUBSTRING(r.XCL_088, 1, INSTR(r.XCL_088, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60)

           + (CAST(SUBSTRING(r.XCL_088, INSTR(r.XCL_088, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) AS time_in_seconds
    FROM results r
    WHERE r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, td.total_points, AVG(fl.time_in_seconds) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds
FROM top_driver td
JOIN eligible_drivers d ON td.XCL_034 = d.XCL_034
